subject: mudsnout
disposition: Disabled asset-local review candidate; ordinary species selection remains unchanged
reference_author: Built-in imagegen, owner-authorized original character reference
reference_prompt: Draft an original Tetherbound Mudsnout creature reference using the supplied established character image as identity reference. ONE full-body three-quarter studio view of the same appealing stout brown woodland boar: broad friendly dark eyes, tan/brown round muzzle with two visible nostrils, two short ivory tusks curving outward, upright rounded boar ears with brown interiors, chunky short legs with divided dark hooves, a short tufted tail, sculpted brown fur and grey-brown earth clods with small ochre leaf-like plates along the shoulders and back. Preserve the recognizable face, stout proportions, mottled natural brown palette and designed dorsal clod ridge. Neutral standing quadruped with four separate grounded feet, visible shoulder/elbow and hip/knee placement, space between legs, head facing three-quarter camera without twist, tail clearly separate and inside frame. Clean riggable anatomy and broad integrated fur masses, not thin strands or floating pieces. No human, text, ruler, clothing, props, equipment, harness, red markings, extra limbs, particles, dramatic pose or background environment. Entire body and tail inside a light-grey studio frame with neutral soft lighting. Render a clean detailed stylized game creature, not a photorealistic pig; keep the warm original personality.

reference_inspection.riggability: Four separated grounded hooves; distinct shoulders/hips and tail; no hanging whisker rods
reference_inspection.limits: One reference view does not establish reverse anatomy, topology, rig or native art acceptance
